body:
Phase 1 — Dendro G2 (v0.2.0), STAGED scope: #12 rework friction and #13 sealed replay only. FROZEN. pm.manager 19:00Z: proceed with one refine (applied). Interface acceptance (#7, #14, #16, #17, #18) is NOT in this phase; it waits for the first real R1 review (sponsor E1, E3). Delivery handoff is held until R1 merges.

Outcome: the operator breaks an R1 rework number down to the seat pair that carries it, with token cost, and can replay any run bit-identically against a recorded cutoff. Both extend R1; neither changes Amendment 1 (docs/ACCEPTANCE_R1.md, sha256 046c1722).

Journey: (1) R1 report shows M3 rework. (2) The friction matrix names the pairs: handoffs, returns, return rate, rework chains, rework tokens by category; advisory alerts mark the outliers. (3) A trace recomputes any cell (R1 AC7). (4) A sealed run against the manifest reproduces the same totals while agents keep writing.

Acceptance: docs/ACCEPTANCE_G2_STAGED.md (sha256 ed79203c). #12: F12-1..F12-7 (reconcile exactly with R1 M2/M3; the four attribution bands sum to the seat total; categories shown; small-sample guard of 5 handoffs; text-only advisory alerts, rework-token threshold on non-cache-read tokens by default; reused handoff-loop rule; R1 CLI/JSON surface only). #13: F13-1..F13-8 (manifest of lengths, digests and append-only high-water keys; bit-identical sealed totals; growth and partial tails excluded; unsealed runs keep AC8; mismatch refused; mutable-row metrics reproduced or 'not reproducible'; AC12 unchanged; manifest holds no content; within the R1 300 s budget).

Evidence V4 (analyst read-only check, not R1 output): rework is the largest ATTRIBUTED sink (6/44 chains, 46% of chain tokens), and #12's exploratory numbers do not reproduce. 60% of linked tokens are outside any in-progress item (G-U3, on the R1 review agenda). 99% of rework tokens are cache.

Constraints: all R1 constraints; canonical R1 schema only; English; no 'telemetry' wording.
Anti-goals: alerts never act on agents; no metric competing with M2/M3; no live-hash claim; no exploratory number as an acceptance value; no second schema.
Out of scope: Nao and TUI interfaces, alert delivery, continuous mode, prediction (Goal 5), explaining the unattributed 60%.
Assumptions: G-A1..G-A5 (§5). Unknowns for orch.arch: G-U1 sealing SQLite append-only tables by key; G-U2 mutable-row dependence of R1 metrics.
References: docs/ACCEPTANCE_G2_STAGED.md, docs/PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION_G2.md, docs/ACCEPTANCE_R1.md.
